The '''Yelsain system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the large [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yelsain/Legends|Yelsain]].
